_note: The same make_doc -> doc_render pipeline driven well for a ONE-page brief: no cover band (a heading is the masthead — the menu has nothing smaller than a full cover), the brief's numbers only (derived ones are arithmetic on them: 3h40m-2h14m, 31+22+18), each recommendation tied to the driver it fixes, then the chart tool's hbar put in with office edit --chart (a PNG picture in docx).

blocks.title: Q3 support: faster answers, a third of the backlog
blocks.standfirst: Customer support, July to September — 12,480 tickets.

paragraphs: Volume rose 9% and the team still answered faster: the median first response fell by 1h 26m, the backlog is a third of what it was, and CSAT held above target.

blocks.title: Three drivers are 71% of tickets
blocks.standfirst: Each has a fix we can ship in Q4.

blocks.label: Recommendation
blocks.text: Ship all three in Q4, starting with self-serve refunds: billing is the largest driver.
